---
title: "Texas in the 2026 Midterms"
description: A simulation of votes by Texans in the 2026 Midterm Election
author: Ava Li
date: November 5, 2026
format: html
code-fold: true
---
```{r,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)

hisp <- get_acs(
    geography = "county",
    state = "TX",
    variables = c(total = "B03002_001", hispanic = "B03002_012"),
    year = 2024,
    survey = "acs5",
    output = "wide" 
) |> 
    mutate(hisp_share = hispanicE / totalE,
            majority_hisp = hisp_share > 0.5)

write_csv(hisp, "data/tx_hispanic_share.csv")
```

## The Data
The following three data sets used for this project were obtained from various sites:

* 2026 Senate Results by County (unofficial, Nov 4 2026, 4:48 pm CST) - [Texas Secretary of State's Election Results](https://goelect.txelections.civixapps.com/ivis-enr-ui/contestdetails?officeID=5075&officeName=U.%20S.%20SENATOR%20&officeType=FEDERAL%20OFFICES&from=race)

* 2024 Presidential Results by County (Nov 26, 2024) - [Texas Secretary of State's Election Results](https://results.texas-election.com/contestdetails?officeID=1001&officeName=PRESIDENT%2FVICE-PRESIDENT&officeType=FEDERAL%20OFFICES&from=frace)

* Hispanic Population Share by County - U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates, Table B03002, accessed via the tidycensus R package
